title: Package Installation and Tool Setup Failures
underlying_need: Users need a stable environment where packages and tools can be installed or upgraded without errors or missing components.

title: App broken after updates
underlying_need: A stable, functional version of Termux that works reliably after installation and updates.

title: Typing and cursor navigation problems
underlying_need: Users need reliable keyboard input and full cursor movement support so they can enter and edit commands without errors or delays.

title: Insufficient Features and Documentation
underlying_need: Users need more functionality, better documentation, and access to system features such as root, additional packages, and UI controls to fully utilize Termux.

title: App fails to install or run on devices
underlying_need: Customers need a reliably installable and compatible version of Termux that works across their Android devices and updates without breaking functionality.

title: Termux Installation and Launch Failures
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to install and start Termux across devices and Android versions without crashes or missing functionality.

title: Package Repository and SSH Access Failures
underlying_need: Users need a stable, accessible package repository and functional SSH capabilities so they can install, update, and manage software without errors.

title: Poor usability and lack of guidance
underlying_need: Users need clearer onboarding, intuitive interface, and better documentation to understand how to use the app and its permissions without confusion.

title: Commands Not Executing Properly
underlying_need: The app must reliably run standard Linux commands without errors or hangs after installation or updates.

title: Pkg/apt package installation failures
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to update and install packages in Termux without errors or missing installations.

title: Storage permission and access failures
underlying_need: Users need reliable access to both internal and external storage so they can read, write, manage files and install packages without permission errors.

title: Termux performance and slow behavior
underlying_need: Customers need the app to run responsively and complete installations and package operations quickly, without noticeable lag after updates.

title: Bootstrap Package Installation Failure
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to download and install the required bootstrap files so the app can be set up and used.

title: Python package installation failures
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to install Python packages (e.g., numpy, scipy, pygame, nltk, spaCy, Pillow) within Termux without errors.

title: False network connectivity detection
underlying_need: Users need the app to accurately recognize a working internet connection and allow network commands to function reliably.

title: Permission and Access Denial Issues
underlying_need: Users need the app to obtain and retain the necessary permissions and authentication to function fully without being blocked or banned.

title: Root Access Not Available
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to execute commands with root privileges within Termux on their Android devices.

title: Metasploit Installation Failures
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to install and update Metasploit and related packages within Termux without errors or hangs.

title: Unstable and Lost Sessions
underlying_need: Users need their terminal sessions to remain active and retain history across app minimization, switching, and prolonged use.

title: OpenSSH package installation failures
underlying_need: Users need a reliable way to locate and install the OpenSSH package (and related tools) without broken links or missing dependencies.

title: Package Mirror Connectivity Failure
underlying_need: Users need reliable access to functional package mirrors so they can update the app and install or upgrade packages without errors.
